notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Clues.
easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
